profile.headline: Full Stack Developer
profile.summary:
I come from a sales background with over eight years of experience in various industries. Then I found a passion for technology and programming, which led me to attend Ironhack’s Web Development bootcamp. Now, I’m looking to bring my skills together and drive revenue for a company with technology.


Technology specialists: Node.js, HTML, JavaScript, CSS, Mongo DB, Express.js, and software development

GitHub profile: https://github.com/rmg2995

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•Implemented and built A/B test designs that helped improve the UI, resulting in over $3 million increase in revenue. 
•Injected jquery and javascript through Optimizely to override current design that was built by the UX/UI team.
•Developed and coordinated  features in different projects written in React.js and Angular.
•Ensures all tests and features go through multiple QA’s (functional, visual, ADA).
positions.insights: Skills: jQuery · Arrow Functions · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · HTML · React.js

positions.title: Sales Assistant
positions.description:
•Call workers from Miami Dade County to schedule a meeting about their retirement.                                 
•Inform workers on how their retirement works with the Florida Retirement System and the
 additional options they provide.
•Listen to clients to ensure a tailored plan designed to maximize their satisfaction.
•Give specific advice to clients on how they should save and invest for their future.

positions.title: Banker 1
positions.description:
•Conducted weekly audits on money orders and cashier’s checks.
•Ensured signature cards were updated daily.
•Consistently provided excellent customer service and catered to clients’ wants.
•Referred new clients to the financial service specialist to open accounts.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
•Assisted customers in finding the product and plan that best fit their needs and interests
•Handled the cash and card payments and worked the cash register
•Completed phone callbacks to ensure customer satisfaction
•Organized merchandise and managed inventory

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
•Assisted customers in finding the product that best fit their needs and desires.
•Assisted store manager in managing the store and merchandise.
•Consistently provided “WOW!” customer service internally and externally.
•Worked the cash register and handled cash and card payments.

positions.title: District Leader
positions.description:
•Completed calls to schedule meetings with potential clients
•Prepared and delivered presentations on the financial foundation and the importance of
  protecting your family financially
•Provided exceptional customer service by tailoring financial plans to fit the clients’ needs
•Recruited and coached new agents to find their own success

projects.title: BATMAN VS JOKERS
projects.description:
A one-player game where you shoot batarangs at Jokers while you try to survive for as long as you can.  
Technologies Used: JavaScript, Canvas, CSS, Git, and HTML.

projects.title: GoldBudget
projects.description:
An upgraded version of IronBudget, a full-stack web application that lets you track your income and expenses.
Technologies Used: React.js, JavaScript, HTML, Git, GitHub, SASS, Axios, and CSS.
